missing.name: AWS Madison County and Ridgeland twin campuses
missing.why: $10B, GCs Yates, Gray and Haskell named, opening by 2027; only lumped inside the Amazon row.

missing.name: Amazon / STACK Caddo and Bossier campuses (other than Blanchard)
missing.why: $12B (Feb 2026) for several 2-3M sq ft campuses, later raised to $18B for three; only one site is in the list.

missing.name: SB Energy PORTS Technology Campus
missing.why: DOE-announced 10 GW data center plus gas generation, SB Energy lead, $10B for an 800 MW first stage; construction start planned 2026 but unconfirmed. Borderline.

missing.name: Fermi America Project Matador
missing.why: Up to 11 GW planned; reports of stalled construction and no tenant through spring 2026, later reports of a TensorWave lease. Include only if active work is verified.

may_not_belong.name: Anthropic-Fluidstack sites
may_not_belong.why: No named site or MW; a $50B commitment, not a project. Likely overlaps TeraWulf/Cipher sites that may sit under other trackers, so double-count risk.

may_not_belong.name: Google Texas campuses (Armstrong, Haskell and others)
may_not_belong.why: $40B covers solar, storage, training and existing Midlothian and Dallas sites, not only three new campuses; no construction status found.

may_not_belong.name: Amazon campuses (Mississippi, North Carolina, Pennsylvania)
may_not_belong.why: Three states bundled in one row; NC and PA only announced, no construction status; Mississippi $10B campuses and the $12B add-on are separate projects.

may_not_belong.name: Microsoft-Crusoe Abilene expansion
may_not_belong.why: Separate adjacent campus from Stargate Abilene (not a double count) but only at site prep, first building mid-2027, so spend is not yet in the ramp.

may_not_belong.name: Project Jupiter
may_not_belong.why: The $165B is a bond authorization, not spend; sources report the first phase about 26% complete and months behind, and lawsuits pending, so timing is uncertain.

may_not_belong.name: Prairie Ridge Phase 1 and Nebius Birmingham, buildings 1-2
may_not_belong.why: Dodge-sourced valuations with no tenant or named financing; TDLR shows only $72.6M for Prairie Ridge Building 1, so the $5B value may be campus-wide. Nebius faces litigation.

may_not_belong.name: Colossus 2
may_not_belong.why: Straddles Memphis TN and Southaven MS; $20B is the Southaven site only, so cost and location can be misassigned.

may_not_belong.name: Meta Hyperion and Meta El Paso
may_not_belong.why: Both are financed through JVs where Meta is a minority owner and tenant, so 'owner = Meta' is wrong; spend is still private construction but a funding-basis issue for any 'who pays' column.
